p.cointrack.summary: A crypto portfolio tracker: log your buys and sells, then see what your holdings are worth today and how much you've gained or lost.
p.cointrack.why: Pulls live prices from the CoinGecko API, charts portfolio value over time, and keeps accounts safe with hashed passwords and prepared SQL statements throughout.
p.calorie.summary: Log what you eat, set a daily calorie goal, and see how the last seven days went.
p.calorie.why: A full-stack TypeScript app on the Next.js App Router, with Supabase for sign-in and storage and a chart-based weekly report.
p.mt5.summary: A trading bot for MetaTrader 5 that opens trades when fast and slow moving averages cross and RSI confirms the move.
p.mt5.why: Object-oriented MQL5 split into small classes (signals, positions, grid, trailing stop, drawdown guard, on-chart dashboard). It checks the trend on three timeframes before every trade.
